import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort()
    t = int(input())
    max_count = 0
    for left in range(n):
        # Find the first index where value > a[left] + t
        right = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[left] + t, left, n)
        max_count = max(max_count, right - left)
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
